cases.name: Native confirmed request, dispatch and HCM receipt create real stock and an immutable PDF before deletion
Server enforces Admin-only deletion and blocks self-deletion through any sibling membership
Exact email, reason, membership version and preview fingerprint reject mismatched or stale targets
Deletion retries commit exactly once with one immutable receipt and audit event
All identity memberships and sessions are revoked; deleted accounts leave current Admin/dealer lists and remain in deleted history
Unlock, role edits, Admin reset, dealer reactivation and forgotten-password flows cannot resurrect a deleted identity
Confirmed snapshots and PDF bytes, stock movements/balances, receivables and partner rows remain byte-for-byte unchanged
Pending invitation is revoked, cannot activate, and cannot be resent after deletion
Concurrent Admin deletions serialize, recheck the actor and preserve an active administrator
Password-reset versus deletion race completes without deadlock or login resurrection
MCP native preview and DELETE use the same validation, business retention and retry-safe result
All pre-existing QA credentials remain unchanged
